name: Send Notification
description: Sends (or tests) a push notification via Pushover, Prowl or both. The banner shows which are set up in Secrets Manager and, for Pushover, your devices. Fields marked 'Pushover:' or 'Prowl:' only apply to that service and are ignored by the other. Other scripts send their own alerts with the shared notify_send.py helper (see SCRIPTING.md).

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message (Pushover allows 1,024 characters, Prowl 10,000; longer is trimmed)

values_ui_mapping.2: 2 Emergency (Pushover repeats every minute for an hour until acknowledged)

parameters.name: pushover_url_title
parameters.description: Pushover: text shown for the link, optional

parameters.name: pushover_device
parameters.description: Pushover: only this device ((default) = all your devices)

parameters.name: pushover_ttl
parameters.description: Pushover: delete the message from your devices after this many seconds, optional (not for Emergency)

parameters.name: prowl_application
parameters.description: Prowl: sender name shown on the notification

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional: test a key before saving it - a Pushover app token or Prowl API key for this run only (pick Pushover or Prowl above). Leave blank to use Secrets Manager.

parameters.name: user_key
parameters.description: Optional, Pushover only: user key for this run. Leave blank to use Secrets Manager.
